test_title: PYST 45: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 7th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A certain sum borrowed at 7.5% p.a. at simple interest amounts to ₹16,950 in 5(1)/(2) years. What will be the simple interest (in ₹) on the same sum at the same rate in 8(1)/(4) years?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total amount % for 5.5 years at 7.5% = 100% + (7.5 × 5.5)% = 141.25%

Total interest % for 8.25 years at 7.5% = (7.5 × 8.25)% = 61.875%

Given 141.25% → ₹16,950 ⇒ 1% → 16,950 ÷ 141.25 = ₹120

Required Simple Interest = 61.875% × 120 = ₹7,425

**∴ The correct answer is ₹7425.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Rate (R) = 7.5% p.a.

Time (T₁) = 5.5 years

Amount (A) = ₹16,950

Time (T₂) = 8.25 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Amount (A) = P + SI
